During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Task Force Starfall]] '''attacked''' the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']] shortly after it left [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]].
